translations.governance.title: Procurement governance
translations.governance.intro: Rules every tender, decision and award in your company follows. Changes apply to work done from now on; recorded decisions keep the rules they were made under.
translations.governance.defaults: Your company uses the standard settings. Saving records them as your own.
translations.governance.adminActs: Company Admins also act in procurement
translations.governance.adminActsHelp: Off: Company Admins manage users, settings, policies and the approval matrix only. Give anyone who sources, tenders, evaluates, decides or approves a procurement role (a person may hold up to three roles).
translations.governance.minBidsHelp: Fewer eligible bids flag limited competition, and the decision needs a justification. 1 turns the flag off.
translations.governance.toleranceHelp: An award above the package estimate by more than this needs an over-budget justification.
translations.governance.validityDeadline: The submission deadline in force at closing
translations.governance.validitySubmission: When the bid (or its latest revision) was submitted
translations.governance.pricingBasisRequired: Every tender must state its VAT basis before it is published
translations.governance.pricingBasisHint: Bids then confirm the basis or state their own; a bid on another basis is compared only after a VAT-basis adjustment. Your company's choice — nothing is set by country.
translations.governance.independentShortlist: A shortlist is approved by someone other than who prepared or last changed it
translations.governance.independentPublish: A tender is published by someone other than who prepared or last changed it
translations.governance.independentHint: Four eyes: off by default. A preparer can always mark a shortlist or tender ready, so the approver knows it is waiting.
translations.governance.fastPath: Allow a low-value fast path for approved vendors
translations.governance.fastPathHint: Off by default. When on, and four eyes on shortlists is off, a package whose estimate is at most this amount in this currency can add approved vendors, qualify them and approve the shortlist in one step, with a reason. The approval is marked fast path.
translations.governance.resubmissions: Revisions a firm may submit before the deadline
translations.governance.resubmissionsHint: A firm may replace its submitted bid with a revised one this many times until the deadline (0 makes a submission final). Every submission is kept; the latest one at closing is opened.
translations.governance.bidPeriodHint: A tender is never published with less time to bid than the shortest period (1 hour by default). Below the normal period, the tender builder warns before publishing.
translations.governance.outsidePortal: Allow recording bids received outside the portal
translations.governance.outsidePortalHint: Off by default. When on, a Procurement Manager may record a bid a firm sent by email, by hand or by courier before the deadline, with the original files and an attestation; a second user confirms it before the bids are opened, and the firm is emailed a receipt.
translations.governance.criteriaDeclaration: Declare the evaluation criteria before publication
translations.governance.criteriaDeclarationHint: When required, a tender names its technical scorecard policy and its recommendation policy before it is published. The published revision records the exact versions, before any price is seen; choosing other criteria after opening needs a reason and is flagged to approvers.
translations.governance.panelMinimumHint: 1 by default. An evaluation is completed only when every opened bid has at least this many current submitted scorecards; a tender may set its own when its evaluation starts.
translations.governance.divergence: Flag evaluator totals further apart than (points out of 100)
translations.governance.moderationRequired: Require a moderation note when scores diverge
translations.governance.moderationHint: Scores are never averaged. When on, an evaluation is completed only after the panel has recorded how it reconciled each divergent bid.
translations.governance.noticeTimingHint: The awarded firm is told at once. Holding the other notices until it accepts means a firm that is later awarded after a decline never received a "not selected". Each award may choose otherwise, and reserve bids are told only when you decide.
translations.governance.targetsHint: Leave empty for none. With a target, "My work" shows when each item is due and when it is overdue.
translations.governance.targetEvaluation: Evaluation, days after the bids are opened
translations.governance.targetApproval: Each approval step, days after it starts

translations.matrix.caption: Approval rules in the order they are checked
translations.matrix.none: No approval rule yet: every decision needs one approval by an Approver/Director.
translations.policy.name: Name
translations.matrix.priorityHint: The lowest number is checked first.
translations.matrix.currencyHint: Needed only with a value range; without one the rule matches any currency.

translations.import.guideCode: Required. Your permanent code for the firm. A code already in your directory is skipped, or only completed when you choose to add missing details. Repeat a code on further rows to add more contacts.
translations.import.guideRegistration: Registration numbers. Spaces and dashes are ignored; each number may belong to one subcontractor only.

translations.tenderInvitation.emailNewLink: Email the new link to the recipient
translations.tenderInvitation.revokeBody: The firm is withdrawn from this tender: its link stops working and nothing more is sent. This cannot be undone.
translations.tenderInvitation.secondRecipientHint: Another contact of the same firm receives its own personal link by email. Either person can answer and work on the firm's one bid; the record shows which link acted.
translations.tenderInvitation.removeSecondHint: The second recipient's link stops working at once. The first recipient's link is not affected.
translations.tenderInvitation.recipientHint: Earlier emails stay recorded with the address they went to, and emails not yet sent are withdrawn. The current link keeps working: replace the link if the previous recipient must lose access.
translations.tenderInvitation.firmLinkShown: This firm's personal link was shown to a user by an earlier version, so for its protection it can now only view the invitation. Replace the link and email the new one so the firm can answer and bid again.
translations.tenderInvitation.viewLinkWarning: Anyone with this link can see the tender and its documents, but nobody can answer or bid with it. {$START_TAG_BDI}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_TAG_BDI} answers and bids only through the personal link in its invitation email; resend the invitation if the firm needs it again.
translations.tenderInvitation.copyFailed: The link could not be copied automatically. It is selected: copy it with your keyboard.

translations.tenderInvitation.replacedSent: The links were replaced and the firm's new personal link is being emailed. Below is the new view-only link.

translations.outside.intro: An exception, used only when a firm could not use its link: the original files, the transcription and an attestation are recorded before the deadline, sealed like any bid, and confirmed by a second user before the bids are opened. The firm is emailed a receipt.
translations.outside.sealed: Confirmed and sealed: like every bid, its content and files open with the bid opening.
translations.outside.confirm: I checked the transcription against the originals — confirm
translations.outside.awaitingConfirmation: Waiting for another user to confirm the transcription. The bids cannot be opened until then.
translations.outside.recordSummary: Record a bid received outside the portal
translations.outside.attestation: Attestation (who received it, how, and why the portal was not used)
translations.outside.recorded: Bid recorded. Another user must confirm the transcription before opening.

translations.addendum.draftHint: Bidders see nothing until you issue it. Once issued an addendum is never edited; a correction is another addendum. Bids already submitted are kept exactly as they are.
translations.addendum.summaryHint: Bidders read this explanation exactly as written, with the documents below.
translations.addendum.acknowledgementHint: Each invited firm must confirm it received and reviewed this addendum before it can submit a bid. It is not acceptance of any commercial term.
translations.addendum.deadlineHint: Optional. Only later than the current deadline, in {$START_TAG_BDI}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_TAG_BDI}. After the deadline an addendum must set one.
translations.addendum.replaceSchedule: This addendum replaces the price schedule
translations.addendum.scheduleHint: The new schedule is in force from the next revision. Bids already submitted keep the items they priced; at leveling, items they never priced show as missing scope.
translations.addendum.documentsHint: The current revision's documents stay unless you replace or withdraw them; earlier revisions keep theirs.
translations.addendum.issueByLeadership: A Procurement Manager or Company Admin issues the addendum.
translations.addendum.issueBody: It becomes addendum {$INTERPOLATION} and tender revision {$INTERPOLATION_1}. Every invited firm is emailed and sees it through its own link. It can never be edited afterwards.
translations.addendum.issueAck: Each firm must acknowledge it before submitting a bid.
translations.addendum.discardBody: Nothing was sent to bidders. The draft is kept in the record and a new one can be prepared.
translations.extend.title: Extend the submission deadline
translations.extend.help: The deadline only ever moves later. Every invited firm is emailed; their links and kept drafts follow the new deadline, and a draft kept after the deadline becomes editable again. Submitted bids stay as they are.
translations.extend.zone: In {$START_TAG_BDI}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_TAG_BDI}, at least one hour from now.
translations.addendum.saved: Addendum draft saved. Bidders see nothing until it is issued.
translations.addendum.fileTooLarge: {$name} is larger than 25 MB and was not added.

translations.extend.done: Deadline extended to {$deadline}. Every invited firm is being emailed; kept drafts can be edited again.

translations.tenderBuilder.documentHelp: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, DWG, PNG, JPG, CSV or text, up to {$INTERPOLATION} MB each. Files are checked for type and size; they are not scanned for viruses, so attach only files you trust.
translations.tenderBuilder.requirementsIntro: What every response must contain. Bidders see these requirements when they open their invitation.

translations.tenderBuilder.criteriaRequiredHint: Your company requires this tender to declare its technical scorecard policy and its recommendation policy before it is published.
translations.tenderBuilder.criteriaPinned: Declared at publication: {$START_TAG_BDI}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_TAG_BDI} (version {$INTERPOLATION_1}) for technical scoring and {$START_TAG_BDI}{$INTERPOLATION_2}{$CLOSE_TAG_BDI} (version {$INTERPOLATION_3}) for the recommendation.
translations.tenderBuilder.criteriaShownToBidders: Bidders are shown the criteria and weights.

translations.tenderBuilder.criteriaDisclose: Show the criteria and weights to bidders
translations.tenderBuilder.criteriaHint: Publication records the versions in force, before any price is seen. Choosing other criteria after opening needs a reason and is flagged to approvers.
translations.tenderBuilder.pricingRequiredHint: Your company requires every tender to state its VAT basis before it is published.
translations.tenderBuilder.termsHint: Every bid answers these, and leveling shows the answers side by side. Percentages have at most two decimals; nothing is rounded.
translations.tenderBuilder.requiredDocsHelp: One per line, for example "Priced BOQ" or "Method statement" (up to 20).
translations.tenderBuilder.shortlistSource: From the approved shortlist, round {$INTERPOLATION}, approved by {$START_TAG_BDI}{$INTERPOLATION_1}{$CLOSE_TAG_BDI} on {$INTERPOLATION_2}. Each firm is re-checked when the tender is published.

translations.tenderBuilder.inviteeCount: Invitees: {$INTERPOLATION}. Each receives its own personal link; no bidder can see who else is invited.

translations.tenderBuilder.questionsHelp: Optional. Shown to bidders as the last day for questions.
translations.tenderBuilder.remindersHelp: Sent to invitees who have not declined, before the deadline. Choose up to {$INTERPOLATION}.

translations.tenderBuilder.readyToPublish: Ready to publish — marked by {$START_TAG_BDI}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_TAG_BDI}, {$INTERPOLATION_1}. Any change clears it.
translations.tenderBuilder.fourEyes: Your company requires the tender to be published by someone other than who prepared or last changed it.

What bidders see — scope, requirements, documents and deadline — is frozen and can no longer be edited here. The tender uses one of your plan's active-tender places.
translations.tenderBuilder.cancelBody: Nothing has been sent. The draft stays on record as cancelled, and a new tender can be created for the work package.
translations.tenderBuilder.removeDocumentBody: It will not be part of the published tender.
translations.tenderBuilder.removeInviteeBody: Nothing was sent to this firm yet.
translations.tenderBuilder.noScorecardPolicy: No scorecard policy is active. Bids can be received, but the evaluation cannot start until {$roles} activates one.
translations.tenderBuilder.noScorecardPolicyUnnamed: No scorecard policy is active. Bids can be received, but the evaluation cannot start until one is activated.

translations.tenderBuilder.noRecommendationPolicyUnna: No recommendation policy is active. Bids can be received, but the recommendation cannot be computed until one is activated.

translations.tenderBuilder.published: Tender published. Invitation emails are being sent.
translations.tenderBuilder.cancelled: Draft cancelled. It stays on record.
translations.tenderBuilder.stale: Someone else changed this tender. The latest version is shown; check it and try again.

translations.clar.finalHint: An answer is final. A correction needs an addendum.
translations.clar.visibilityPrivateHint: No other bidder sees the question or the answer. You can publish it later.
translations.clar.visibilityAllHint: Every invited firm sees the question and the answer, never who asked. This cannot be undone.
translations.clar.publishedLabel: Question as all bidders will read it
translations.clar.publishedMissing: Write the question as all bidders will read it.
translations.clar.publishedHint: Remove anything that identifies the firm that asked (its name, people or references). Other bidders never see who asked.
translations.clar.submitPrivate: Send the answer to this firm

translations.control.closedDeadlineTitle: This tender closed at its deadline.
translations.control.closedDeadlineBody: Responses stopped at {$START_TAG_BDI}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_TAG_BDI}. Nobody had to close it by hand.
translations.control.closedHint: No firm can submit or change a bid any more. Submitted bids stay sealed until they are opened for evaluation. Closing a tender does not accept, recommend or award any bidder.
translations.control.evaluationOpened: The bids were opened on {$INTERPOLATION}. Evaluators work in the evaluation workspace.
translations.control.evaluationReady: The tender is closed. Authorized buyers can open the submitted bids for evaluation.
translations.control.evaluationSealed: Submitted bids stay sealed while the tender is open.
translations.control.evaluationOpenLink: Go to bid opening and evaluation
translations.control.awarded: {$START_TAG_STRONG}Awarded{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} on {$INTERPOLATION}. The tender and its evaluation are read-only; the award baseline is in the decision workspace.
translations.control.awardHint: Negotiation rounds ask selected firms for revised or best and final offers. The decision workspace holds the recommendation, the approvals and the award.
translations.control.countIntendsNotSubmitted: Intends to bid, not yet submitted
translations.control.deliveryHonesty: "Accepted by mail server" means the mail server took the email; it does not prove the email reached an inbox. "Opened the link" is recorded only when the bidder opens its secure link.
translations.control.bidsSealed: Bids stay sealed here: you see who submitted and when, with a receipt reference and a fingerprint of the exact submission — not the prices or the content. Opening bids is part of evaluation.
translations.control.closeEarlyNeedsBid: The tender can be closed early once at least one bid has been submitted.
translations.control.cancelBody: Bidders' links will show that the tender is cancelled, scheduled reminders stop and emails still waiting are withdrawn. The invitations and their history are kept.
translations.control.closeWithoutAwardHeading: Close this tender without an award?
translations.control.closeWithoutAwardBody: Your plan ends at evaluation, so this tender is not awarded in the product. Closing it records why, keeps the bids and the evaluation exactly as they are and frees its tender slot. It is not a cancellation, and no bidder is emailed.
translations.control.closeEarlyBody: Closing stops responses now, before the deadline. It is not a cancellation: the tender proceeds with the bids already submitted, which are kept exactly as submitted. It does not accept, recommend or award any bidder.
